name: AiFax
summary: HIPAA fax with AI summaries, patient matching and filing to the Hint chart
overview: AiFax is HIPAA-compliant cloud fax with AI built in. Every incoming fax is summarized in about a minute, matched to the right patient by name and date of birth, and filed into that patient's chart in Hint as a document, within what Hint allows. Unsure matches go to staff review, never to a guess. Two ways to start, with the same service either way: switch to AiFax and keep your fax number, or keep your current fax provider and forward your faxes to AiFax. HIPAA compliant with a signed BAA.
